disposition_reason: Prints per-sample copper and lead for 25 raw milks and 15 market yoghurt and ghee samples from Chittagong.

study.design: Survey of raw farm milk and market yoghurt and ghee
study.origin: Raw milk from dairy farms around industrial or waste disposal areas of Chittagong city, Bangladesh
study.market: Yoghurt and ghee from local markets in Chittagong city
study.method: Acid digestion (liquids) or dry ashing (solids); AAS (Analytik Jena ZEEnit 700P)
study.qa: Calibration standards 0.40, 0.80, 1.20 ppm; laboratory said to have a quality assurance scheme; no CRM or recovery reported
